leader_substitution_note: 512100.SS (中证1000) was the original leader for small-cap, but Yahoo returned only 137 bars. Substitute 159915.SZ (创业板) which represents small-growth and has full history.
followers: 27 ETFs (the remaining after dropping 4 truncated tickers and 3 leaders)
operators: rolling 60d cov(r_i, r_L) / var(r_L) for follower-leader beta
neutralization: self-projection diagonal zeroed out (a leader never receives its own signal)
expected_sign: positive (top-quintile beta-projected leader return predicts top-quintile next-day follower return)
deployable_metric: net-Sharpe-at-5bps long-short (cost-adjusted is the only honest metric for daily-rebalance)
caveats: Cost wall is binding: net @ 5bps could be much smaller than gross
Mechanical stale-price lead-lag must be ruled out by IC@k=0 check
Bull-market regime asymmetry: 2020 small>large, 2024 large>small — multi-leader smooths
mandatory_diagnostics: IC at k=0 (contemporaneous) — if huge, mechanism is stale price not info diffusion
